summary.text: Anna Eskamani represents District 42, part of Orange County, in the Florida House of Representatives. According to the House, Eskamani was elected in 2018 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: The House lists Eskamani's residence as Orlando, where Eskamani was born, and an occupation of nonprofit professional.

Eskamani's listed education at the University of Central Florida includes bachelor's degrees (2008-2012), master's degrees in public administration and nonprofit management (2012-2015) and a PhD in public affairs (2016-2024).

sources.title: Biography for Representative Anna V. Eskamani
